items.title: What Does IBM (IBM) Gain From Its $240 Million AI Infrastructure Deal?
items.summary: International Business Machines (NYSE: IBM) agreed a multi year partnership with Together AI to build a US$240 million Nvidia powered AI inference cluster on IBM Cloud. The cluster will use Nvidia HGX B300 systems with Blackwell processors and is planned to be IBM Cloud's first dedicated large scale AI inference platform.
